tasks.label: 📋 Logcat — Gray Part Only
tasks.command: $adb="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe"; & $adb logcat -v time -s WelcomePortal TrackingDispatch ReachDispatch AppEntry NetWire PushRelay AlertPortal StreamPortal

tasks.label: 📋 Logcat — All App Logs
tasks.command: $adb="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe"; $pkg='com.legendfool.foollegends.debug'; $pid=(& $adb shell pidof $pkg).Trim(); if($pid){ & $adb logcat --pid=$pid -v time } else { Write-Host 'App not running — launch it first' }

tasks.label: 🔴 Clear App Data (reset to first launch)
tasks.command: $adb="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe"; & $adb shell pm clear com.legendfool.foollegends.debug; Write-Host 'Done — next launch = first launch'
